welcome.speaker: kit
welcome.text: Welcome to Boston. Fair warning, every week there's a new law from London and every week we print the angry pamphlet about it.

docks_sugar_act.speaker: customs_officer
docks_sugar_act.text: Every barrel of molasses is checked now. Smugglers go to the admiralty court. No jury.

docks_sugar_act.speaker: merchant
docks_sugar_act.text: No jury? Then a British judge decides everything.

market_currency_act.speaker: clerk
market_currency_act.text: Colonial paper money is no longer allowed for debts.

market_currency_act.speaker: farmer
market_currency_act.text: Then how am I supposed to pay anyone?

shop_stamp_act.speaker: stamp_distributor
shop_stamp_act.text: Every newspaper, legal paper, almanac, and deck of playing cards needs a tax stamp.

shop_stamp_act.speaker: kit
shop_stamp_act.text: Paper? They're taxing *our* paper? This is the first tax Parliament has put directly on us.

tavern_quartering_act.speaker: sergeant
tavern_quartering_act.text: The colony will provide quarters and supplies for His Majesty's soldiers.

tavern_quartering_act.speaker: tavern_keeper
tavern_quartering_act.text: We pay for an army we never asked for.

representation.speaker: kit
representation.text: We didn't vote for Parliament. Not one colonist sits in it. That's the whole problem. No taxation without representation.

after_townshend.speaker: sivart
after_townshend.text: So they took one tax away and then said they could tax anything they want.
